query:
SELECT m.name, m.cas_number, ir.restriction_type, ir.reason_for_restriction, ir.category_4 as parfum_limit
FROM ifra_restrictions ir
JOIN molecules m ON ir.molecule_id = m.id
WHERE m.cas_number IN ('106-24-1', '106-22-9', '93-15-2', '484-20-8');
